input.summary: login() now raises LoginError("email required") when the email is missing, blank or None. I added a parametrized regression test. It failed before the fix and the whole suite passes after it.

claims.statement: Before the fix, a missing email raised KeyError (the cause of the 500). A None email raised AttributeError. A blank email did not raise at all.
login() now reads the email with payload.get('email') or '' and raises LoginError('email required') if it is empty after normalisation.
After the change all 5 tests pass, including the existing ones.

input.uncertainty: I only ran the unit tests on login(). I did not check the HTTP layer, which isn't in this repo, so I haven't confirmed that a LoginError there becomes a non-500 response. A non-string email, such as a number, would still raise AttributeError.
